fields.label: Org Name
fields.help: The org to ask. This workflow must be one of its automation roles, so the answer has somewhere to go.

fields.label: Ask Role
fields.help: Role id to ask. Leave empty for the org's coordinator.

fields.label: Question
fields.help: Supports {{$json.field}} placeholders. The run pauses until the role replies.

fields.label: Timeout (seconds)
fields.help: How long to wait for a reply before the node fails.

fields.label: Output Key
fields.help: Where the reply is stored on the output item.
